text:
Even her perfumes last longer than she!

See here the flasks, which she scarcely used,

and which reconstruct for me the subtle

trace she left in the house...


Hermetically enclosed,

the essence in its bottles will not escape.

While the spirit of my dearly beloved,

more imponderable, more tenuous perhaps,

flew from her lips, enchanted retort,

and where can it be!

translation.title: On Finding Some Flasks of Essence
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the contrast between lasting perfume and vanished spirit.
